CustomField.description: The dollar balance at which the nightly job opens a Delinquency Case. FSD references an opening threshold five times and never quantifies it - see the open questions in this build’s report, which also asks whether this and the months threshold combine with AND or OR. There is no hardcoded fallback in Apex: if this is unset the run halts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Open a Case once the balance reaches this amount.
CustomField.label: Opening Threshold Amount
